assets.prompt:
Generate a transparent PNG sprite atlas (RGBA, real alpha channel). Square canvas, exactly 4 EQUAL COLUMNS by 3 EQUAL ROWS in a regular grid. 12 separate simple cartoon equipment icons, one centered in every cell. No visible grid, no boxes, no text. Every icon entirely INSIDE its own cell with at least 16% padding from all four cell edges. Icons must not overlap or touch. Background of every cell and gaps alpha=0.
Image1 actors.png is the canonical original simple flat pixel cartoon style; image2 icons.png is the canonical thick black pixel contour and readable icon style. Each new equipment icon has a thick BLACK stair-step pixel outline, funny slightly crooked silhouette and ONLY TWO LARGE SOLID COLORED REGIONS PER MATERIAL. Draw every icon like a coarse32x32pixel game icon, flatter and simpler than the icon reference. No detailed painted rendering.
EXACT GRID, left-to-right:
Top row: (1) red office paper utility knife tilted grip lowerleft/tip upperright, one black slider and gray blade; (2) dented palegray tin bowl helmet; (3) palegray short-sleeve starter shirt with simple black collar and two buttons; (4) plain olive worn trousers, two legs and ONE dark knee patch.
Middle row: (1) gray butcher cleaver with brown handle tilted lowerleft/upperright; (2) simple darkgray iron helmet with black horizontal eye slit and gray nose guard; (3) simple olive jacket with black opening and two pockets; (4) olive reinforced trousers with two simple darkgray square knee pads.
Bottom row: (1) simple lavender violet runic sword with single darkviolet zigzag rune, grip lowerleft/tip upperright; (2) simple bronze guard helmet with small darkred crest and black eye opening; (3) simple brickred brigandine vest with brown front and just SIX large square gray rivets; (4) darkblue guard trousers with two plain bronze square knee pads.
Flat color only. No fabric folds, texture, grain, mottling, scratches, dither, realistic shading, gradients, gloss, glow, shadows, scene or other objects. Transparent empty space. Strictly12 separate complete icons in the specified4x3grid.

Atlas padding and background correction prompt:
Edit image1, the12-icon equipment atlas. Preserve ALL12 same equipment identities, same simple pixel cartoon style, same flat colors, same thick black outlines and same4-column3-row order. Make EVERY icon 25 percent smaller around the center of its own regular grid cell, so each object has a generous transparent gap on ALL sides and no object crosses any cell boundary. Keep square canvas. Also remove the entire background completely, including spaces inside the icons. The result MUST be a transparent PNG with a real alpha channel, not an RGB image. Every background pixel must have alpha=0. Opaque objects only, no drop shadows. Images2and3 are canonical style references only. No visible grid or text.

Background correction prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Edit image 1: keep the twelve equipment icons, all their pixelated silhouettes, positions, sizes, proportions, flat colors and black outlines exactly unchanged. Remove the entire background around and between the twelve icons completely, including all background gaps inside objects. The result MUST be a transparent PNG with a real alpha channel, not an RGB image. Every background pixel must have alpha=0. Opaque objects only, no drop shadows. Image 2 and image 3 are canonical style references only. Produce a single square image.
